# Importers

Every importer `queuetruth live import` can run, from the importer registry. Each one is declared next to its code
as an `ImporterDef` (name, kind, typed options model, the formats and files it reads, a docs page); the CLI choices,
`LiveImportSpec.venue`, its JSON Schema enum, the Rust `LiveVenue`, the service's `qt.meta` and this page are all
generated from it. Plugins add importers through the `queuetruth.importers` entry-point group
([Add a backtester](../how-to/add-a-backtester.md) shows the entry-point setup); they are listed by
`queuetruth.live.importers.registry()`, not here.

Kinds: `venue` reads a venue's own records of your account; `sim` reads a simulator's or backtester's output (log
venue `sim:<name>`, for `score --sim-log`); `bot` reads a trading bot's live run (log venue = the exchange).

Options go in `--option KEY=VALUE` (CLI) or as keyword arguments (`queuetruth.import_live(spec, **options)`);
`--tz` and the `--fix-*` flags fill `tz` and `fix`. Values are passed to the importer as given; a wrong type or an
unknown option fails `QT-CONFIG-001` and lists the importer's options. Every importer also takes `account` and the
instrument map (`--account`, `--instrument-map`).

## binance

Binance Spot: orders and fills of your own account.

- `LiveImportSpec.venue`: `binance`; kind `venue`; options model `ImporterOptions`.
- Reads: user-data stream executionReport JSON lines; WebSocket API request/response captures; REST myTrades and allOrders JSON.
- Typical files: `*.jsonl`, `*.json`.
- Guide: [how-to/import-live-logs.md](../how-to/import-live-logs.md#binance).

No options of its own.

## bybit

Bybit v5: orders and fills of your own account.

- `LiveImportSpec.venue`: `bybit`; kind `venue`; options model `ImporterOptions`.
- Reads: private WebSocket order and execution topics (JSON lines); REST execution/list and order/history JSON.
- Typical files: `*.jsonl`, `*.json`.
- Guide: [how-to/import-live-logs.md](../how-to/import-live-logs.md#bybit).

No options of its own.

## ibkr-flex

Interactive Brokers Flex Query Trades: executions of your own account.

- `LiveImportSpec.venue`: `ibkr_flex`; kind `venue`; options model `IbkrFlexOptions`.
- Reads: Flex Query Trades XML; Flex Query Trades CSV.
- Typical files: `*.xml`, `*.csv`.
- Guide: [how-to/import-live-logs.md](../how-to/import-live-logs.md#ibkr-flex).

| Option | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `flex_date_order` | text | mdy or dmy: the order of slash dates (default: inferred per file) |
| `tz` | text | IANA zone of the statement's times (default UTC, with a warning) |

## fix44

FIX 4.4 order-entry and drop-copy logs (QuickFIX C++, J, n, Go and plain FIX logs).

- `LiveImportSpec.venue`: `fix44`; kind `venue`; options model `Fix44Options`.
- Reads: QuickFIX FileLog and FileStore files or directories; one-message-per-line FIX 4.4 logs.
- Typical files: `*.messages.current.log`, `*.messages.log`, `*.body`, `*.header`, `*.seqnums`, `*.log`.
- Guide: [how-to/import-live-logs.md](../how-to/import-live-logs.md#fix44).

| Option | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `fix` | FIX options | LiveImportSpec.fix: delimiter, local_ts_regex, venue_name, ... |
| `tz` | text | IANA zone of log times captured by fix.local_ts_regex without an offset |

## sim-hftbacktest

hftbacktest: the simulator's orders and fills (log venue sim:hftbacktest).

- `LiveImportSpec.venue`: `sim_hftbacktest`; kind `sim`; options model `HftbacktestOptions`.
- Reads: order snapshots of hftbacktest 2.4.4 (Parquet, CSV or JSON lines).
- Typical files: `*.parquet`, `*.csv`, `*.jsonl`.
- Guide: [how-to/import-live-logs.md](../how-to/import-live-logs.md#simulator-output-hftbacktest-nautilus).

| Option | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `key_from_client_id` | true/false or text | use a client id of the form venue:account:id as the order key |
| `map_venue` | text | venue of the instrument-map rows when it differs from venue |
| `order_key_map` | object | {hftbacktest order_id: live order_key} |
| `size_exp` | integer or text | decimal exponent of sizes, -18..18 (default -8) |
| `venue` | text | live venue whose instrument-map rows apply |

## freqtrade

Freqtrade bot: the orders and fills of a live or dry run (log venue = the exchange).

- `LiveImportSpec.venue`: `freqtrade`; kind `bot`; options model `FreqtradeOptions`.
- Reads: trades database (SQLite) of a dry-run or live bot; bot log.
- Typical files: `*.sqlite`, `*.log`.
- Guide: [how-to/reconcile-freqtrade-hummingbot.md](../how-to/reconcile-freqtrade-hummingbot.md#3-against-a-live-bot).

| Option | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `dry_run` | true/false or text | the run is a dry run (default: read from the database) |
| `log_tz` | text | IANA zone of bot log times (default UTC) |
| `map_venue` | text | venue of the instrument-map rows when it differs from venue |
| `order_date_clock` | text | exchange (default) or local: the clock of order dates |
| `pair_tolerance_candles` | integer or text | pairing tolerance in candles (default 1) |
| `price_exp` | integer or text | decimal exponent of prices (default -9) |
| `size_exp` | integer or text | decimal exponent of sizes (default -8) |
| `strategy` | text | strategy name in a backtest result with several |
| `tif` | text | time in force of limit orders (default gtc) |
| `timeframe` | text | candle length, e.g. 5m (default: the backtest's) |
| `venue` | text | the exchange the bot traded on (default: from the config) |

## hummingbot

Hummingbot bot: the orders and fills of a live run (log venue = the exchange market).

- `LiveImportSpec.venue`: `hummingbot`; kind `bot`; options model `HummingbotOptions`.
- Reads: bot database (SQLite); trades CSV.
- Typical files: `*.sqlite`, `trades_*.csv`.
- Guide: [how-to/reconcile-freqtrade-hummingbot.md](../how-to/reconcile-freqtrade-hummingbot.md#part-2-hummingbot-paper-trading-vs-live).

| Option | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `map_venue` | text | venue of the instrument-map rows when it differs from venue |
| `market` | text | the connector market to read when the database holds several |
| `price_exp` | integer or text | decimal exponent of prices (default -9) |
| `size_exp` | integer or text | decimal exponent of sizes (default -8) |
| `venue` | text | log venue (default: the market's exchange) |

## sim-freqtrade

Freqtrade backtest (or dry run) as the simulator arm (log venue sim:freqtrade).

- `LiveImportSpec.venue`: `sim_freqtrade`; kind `sim`; options model `FreqtradeSimOptions`.
- Reads: backtest result zip or JSON; .last_result.json; dry-run trades database.
- Typical files: `backtest-result-*.zip`, `backtest-result-*.json`, `.last_result.json`, `*.sqlite`.
- Guide: [how-to/reconcile-freqtrade-hummingbot.md](../how-to/reconcile-freqtrade-hummingbot.md#part-1-freqtrade-backtest-vs-dry-run-and-live).

| Option | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `dry_run` | true/false or text | the run is a dry run (default: read from the database) |
| `live_dry_run` | true/false or text | dry_run of the pair_with run |
| `live_venue` | text | venue of the pair_with run |
| `log_tz` | text | IANA zone of bot log times (default UTC) |
| `map_venue` | text | venue of the instrument-map rows when it differs from venue |
| `order_date_clock` | text | exchange (default) or local: the clock of order dates |
| `pair_tolerance_candles` | integer or text | pairing tolerance in candles (default 1) |
| `pair_with` | text or path or list | the live bot's database and logs: paired orders take their order_key |
| `price_exp` | integer or text | decimal exponent of prices (default -9) |
| `size_exp` | integer or text | decimal exponent of sizes (default -8) |
| `strategy` | text | strategy name in a backtest result with several |
| `tif` | text | time in force of limit orders (default gtc) |
| `timeframe` | text | candle length, e.g. 5m (default: the backtest's) |
| `venue` | text | the exchange the bot traded on (default: from the config) |

## sim-hummingbot

Hummingbot paper bot as the simulator arm (log venue sim:hummingbot).

- `LiveImportSpec.venue`: `sim_hummingbot`; kind `sim`; options model `HummingbotSimOptions`.
- Reads: paper-trade bot database (SQLite); paper-trade trades CSV.
- Typical files: `*_paper_trade*.sqlite`, `*_papertrade*.sqlite`, `trades_*.csv`.
- Guide: [how-to/reconcile-freqtrade-hummingbot.md](../how-to/reconcile-freqtrade-hummingbot.md#part-2-hummingbot-paper-trading-vs-live).

| Option | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `map_venue` | text | venue of the instrument-map rows when it differs from venue |
| `market` | text | the connector market to read when the database holds several |
| `pair_price_tol` | integer or number or text | price difference still paired (default 0) |
| `pair_window_ms` | integer or text | pairing window in milliseconds (default 1000) |
| `pair_with` | text or path or list | the live bot's database or trades CSV: paired orders take its order_key |
| `price_exp` | integer or text | decimal exponent of prices (default -9) |
| `size_exp` | integer or text | decimal exponent of sizes (default -8) |
| `venue` | text | log venue (default: the market's exchange) |

## sim-backtrader

Backtrader backtest: order and trade notifications (log venue sim:backtrader).

- `LiveImportSpec.venue`: `sim_backtrader`; kind `sim`; options model `BacktraderOptions`.
- Reads: QtOrderLog notification lines (JSON lines); order and trade notification JSON.
- Typical files: `*.jsonl`, `*.json`.
- Guide: [how-to/reconcile-backtrader-vectorbt.md](../how-to/reconcile-backtrader-vectorbt.md#backtrader-add-an-analyzer).

| Option | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `data_tz` | text | IANA zone of naive timestamps (default UTC) |
| `fill_delay_bars` | integer or text | fills k bars after their timestamp (default 0) |
| `instrument` | text | one live instrument name for every order |
| `instruments` | text or object | LABEL:NAME[,LABEL:NAME...] per data feed or column |
| `map_venue` | text | venue of the instrument-map rows when it differs from venue |
| `pair_window_ms` | integer or text | pairing window in milliseconds |
| `pair_with` | text or path or list | canonical live-log directory: paired orders take its order_key |
| `price_exp` | integer or text | decimal exponent of prices (default -9) |
| `size_exp` | integer or text | decimal exponent of sizes (default -8) |
| `timeframe` | text | bar length, e.g. 5m |
| `venue` | text | live venue whose instrument-map rows apply (e.g. binance) |

## sim-vectorbt

VectorBT portfolio: order or trade records (log venue sim:vectorbt).

- `LiveImportSpec.venue`: `sim_vectorbt`; kind `sim`; options model `VectorbtOptions`.
- Reads: Portfolio order or trade records (records_readable as CSV or JSON).

- Guide: [how-to/reconcile-backtrader-vectorbt.md](../how-to/reconcile-backtrader-vectorbt.md#vectorbt-export-the-order-records).

| Option | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `column` | text | the one column label to read (a sweep has several) |
| `data_tz` | text | IANA zone of naive timestamps (default UTC) |
| `fill_delay_bars` | integer or text | fills k bars after their timestamp (default 0) |
| `instrument` | text | one live instrument name for every order |
| `instruments` | text or object | LABEL:NAME[,LABEL:NAME...] per data feed or column |
| `map_venue` | text | venue of the instrument-map rows when it differs from venue |
| `order_type` | text | market (default) or limit: the order type of the records |
| `pair_window_ms` | integer or text | pairing window in milliseconds |
| `pair_with` | text or path or list | canonical live-log directory: paired orders take its order_key |
| `price_exp` | integer or text | decimal exponent of prices (default -9) |
| `size_exp` | integer or text | decimal exponent of sizes (default -8) |
| `timeframe` | text | bar length, e.g. 5m |
| `venue` | text | live venue whose instrument-map rows apply (e.g. binance) |
